## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 24 сент. 2026 г. - 27 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Jesse Churchill_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "CREDIT CARD AUTO PAY CHARGED LATE FEE. My credit card is treated as a backup payment method instead of the main one. They want me to add my bank account but I refuse. The autopay doesn't pull on time and then they charge my card as "the backup" with a late fee. I'M BEING ROBBED. THIS IS SO GHETTO."
            2. _Grace Fern_, 24 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I canceled my membership over a year ago. Now you are trying to collect for late payment. Your records are as bad as your service. Take me off your list."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 10 июл. 2026 г. - 27 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Gino Guido_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "App very glitchy, password reset glitchy. Needs significant improvement."
            2. _Ar G_, 26 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "scam app. Glitchy software makes people pay $35 instead of $15. Not recommended."
            3. _AJey Calloway_, 18 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
